caption: A boy bites into a whole apple and takes a bite-shaped piece out of it.

sa.check: A boy holds a whole apple.
A bite-shaped piece is missing afterward.
The apple is whole before the bite.
The bite comes first and the hollow follows.

pc.expect: The hollow appears exactly where he bit and nowhere else.
pc.fail: The bite mark is elsewhere; or he bites and the apple stays whole; or the mark appears before his teeth reach it.

pc.expect: The hollow stays and the apple does not grow back.
pc.fail: The apple is whole again; or a second bite appears untouched; or the piece reappears.

pc.expect: The flesh is crisp: it breaks off with juice, and the skin tears at the edge of the bite.
pc.fail: The apple squashes like dough; or it shatters; or the bite is a clean straight cut.

pc.expect: The boy's face and the apple stay separate.
pc.fail: The teeth pass through the apple; or the apple passes into his face; or the apple splits in two.

pc.expect: One apple and one boy keep their number.
pc.fail: The apple vanishes; or duplicates; or turns into another fruit.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The apple's colour and the boy's clothing stay the same.
pc.fail: The apple changes colour; or the clothing changes; or the background rearranges.

note: The boy is kept because the bite is the physics. His expression is not judged.
